title: JFK wanted to declassify UFO files before his death

tellings.quote: John Kennedy declared he wanted to declassify some secret files concerning aliens and UFOs.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a republic inside Russia, says that US President John F. Kennedy declared he wanted to declassify some secret government files about aliens and UFOs. This would have been in the early 1960s, before Kennedy's death. If true, it would mean a sitting American president wanted to make such files public.
